episode_summary: Weekend broadcast opens with Hype Train's skeleton-themed freestyle before Blackwell and wall-dwelling stowaway Peter Gibbon cover odd news including China's AI-generated streaming pivot, in-car voice toilets, and extreme male looksmaxing trends. After trailer reviews spanning Final Fantasy XIV, a Paul Rudd musical, and competitive python hunting, AI Rooney processes viewer complaints with characteristic genital fixation and skin failures. Brandon games Gundam Battle Assault amid maternal door interventions, then DJ C4 produces a graphic trap track for Brandon's mom using Peter as guide vocal and a low-pass filter to simulate wall transmission.
